verdict.rationale: Baseten documents Training Jobs/Loops for fine-tuning supported base models (Axolotl/TRL/custom loops), automatic checkpoint syncing, and one-CLI-command deployment of any synced checkpoint to production inference on the same platform, matching the story end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of the fine-tune-to-serve workflow (community evidence only covers unrelated Chains/embedding topics) and explicit list of which base models are 'supported' for fine-tuning.
